text:
Maya: Quickstart refresh — i'm landing a small PR to tighten the hello-world deploy flow + auth snippet. need a quick sanity check on the ephemeral token example for the JS snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321
Sam: i'll take a look in a bit. does the new snippet call `redwood.auth.getEphemeralToken()` or are we still recommending JWT+KMS for private customers?
Maya: going with ephemeral for the quickstart to keep friction low. planned snippet (JS):
```
const token = await client.auth.getEphemeralToken({ ttl: 60 })
await fetch('/deploy', { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } })
```
Sam: couple quick nits: 1) clarify ttl units (seconds) inline. 2) add a single-sentence note that Private deployments should integrate with KMS/JWT for long-lived ops.
Alex: also — the console screenshot still shows env var `REDWOOD_API_KEY`. we standardized on `REDWOOD_TOKEN` last quarter; update the image and callout.
Maya: ugh, thanks. i'll regenerate the screenshot tomorrow.
Ricardo: heads up CI flagged snippet-lint in the branch (no-console + unused-vars). recommend swapping console -> logger or add `// eslint-disable-next-line` for minimal change.
Maya: will push the lint fix in a follow-up commit.
docs-bot: link-checker found 1 broken link: /guides/auth -> 404.
Jen: yep that page moved. point links to /guides/auth-overview instead.
Maya: updated the links in the branch just now and pushed.
Sam: i pulled the branch and ran the tutorial locally. deploy step errors if `PROJECT_REGION` is missing — readers hit this frequently. can we add a "Before you begin" checklist with REDWOOD_TOKEN + PROJECT_REGION?
Maya: good call — i'll add a small preflight checklist block above the deploy step.
Alex: tiny API change: new SDK rename landed in v8.1.0 — `auth.getEphemeralToken()` used to be `auth.ephemeralToken()`. decide whether to pin snippets to sdk@^8.1.0 or keep the old name and note compatibility.
Jen: recommend pinning examples to `sdk@^8.1.0` in package.json so readers don't hit deprecation surprises. add a line in the quickstart mentioning the snippet is shown for v8.1+.
Sam: LGTM once lint and link-check pass.
Maya: thanks all — i'll update the screenshot, pin the SDK version, add the preflight checklist, and fix lint errors. i'll ping here when CI is green. :thumbsup:
Maya: oh — small follow-up: anyone want to verify the new short paragraph about data residency in Private deploys? it should be two sentences max.
Jen: i can proof it after your push.
Maya: awesome, thanks!
